unit: H170 - central sterile supply under the release policy: quarantine, release by a person, biological for implant loads, pack integrity at issue, recall and follow-up

Sets wait in quarantine until a person r.ar: تبقى الأطقم في الحجر حتى يُفرج شخص عن دورتها، والحمولة التي تضم مواد قابلة للزرع تنتظر مؤشرها البيولوجي
Sets wait in quarantine until a person r.en: Sets wait in quarantine until a person releases their cycle; a load with implantable items waits for its biological indicator
Sets wait in quarantine until a person r.fr: Les sets restent en quarantaine jusqu'à ce qu'une personne libère leur cycle ; une charge implantable attend son indicateur biologique

Recording the end means the run met its.ar: تسجيل انتهاء الدورة يعني أنها استوفت برنامجها ونجح مؤشرها الكيميائي. تبقى الأطقم في الحجر حتى يُفرج عن الدورة.
Recording the end means the run met its.en: Recording the end means the run met its programme and the chemical indicator passed. The sets wait in quarantine until the cycle is released.
Recording the end means the run met its.fr: Enregistrer la fin signifie que le cycle a respecté son programme et que l'indicateur chimique est conforme. Les sets restent en quarantaine jusqu'à la libération du cycle.

This cycle is still running.ar: هذه الدورة ما زالت قيد التشغيل
This cycle is still running.fr: Ce cycle est encore en cours
